findings.description: The `if fg:` check treats the valid integer color 0 as absent, so `style(..., fg=0)` silently drops the foreground color. The same truthiness check on `bg` at line 684 drops `bg=0`.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a caller passes fg=0 (ANSI/256-color index 0, black) to style(). Mechanism: the old code tested `fg is not None`, but the new `if fg:` is False for 0, so no escape code is emitted. Impact: the text is rendered without the requested color, with no error.

findings.description: An unknown color name now raises TypeError instead of the ValueError the previous _interpret_color raised, changing the exception type seen by callers.
findings.rationale: Trigger: style(fg='notacolor'). Mechanism: the KeyError from the _ansi_colors lookup is re-raised as TypeError. Impact: existing code or tests that catch ValueError for invalid colors will no longer catch this error.
